items.source: prefix - a filter within the keys in the map: for example, 'beans.' (can be empty or null)
items.translation: prefix - 映射键中的一个过滤器：例如，'beans.'（可以为空或null）

items.source: map - a map of name to property (String or Object). Property values will be strings if coming from a Properties file etc. Property names (keys) must be Strings. Class keys must be Strings.
items.translation: map - 一个将 name 映射到 property（String 或 Object）的映射。如果属性值来自 Properties 文件等，则它们将是字符串。属性名称（键）必须是 String。类键必须是 Strings。

items.source: BeansException - in case of loading or parsing errors

items.source: resource - the resource descriptor for the properties file
items.translation: resource - 属性文件的资源描述符

items.source: encodedResource - the resource descriptor for the properties file, allowing to specify an encoding to use for parsing the file
items.translation: encodedResource - 属性文件的资源描述符，允许指定用于解析该文件的编码。

items.source: rb - the ResourceBundle to load from
items.translation: rb - 要加载的资源包

items.source:
Provides bean definition registration methods for Map/Properties and
ResourceBundle. Typically applied to a DefaultListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 提供用于 Map/Properties 和 ResourceBundle 的 Bean 定义注册方法。通常应用于 DefaultListableBeanFactory。

items.source:
Can be used, for example, for view definition files, to define a parent
with a default view class and common attributes for all views.
View definitions that define their own parent or carry their own
class can still override this.
items.translation: 例如，可用于视图定义文件，以定义具有默认视图类和所有视图通用属性的父级。定义了自身父级或携带自身类的视图定义仍可覆盖此设置。

items.source:
Strictly speaking, the rule that a default parent setting does
not apply to a bean definition that carries a class is there for
backwards compatibility reasons. It still matches the typical use case.
items.translation: 严格来说，默认父设置不适用于带有类的 Bean 定义这一规则是为了向后兼容性而设。它仍然符合典型的使用场景。

items.source:
Similar syntax as for a Map. This method is useful to enable
standard Java internationalization support.
items.translation: 与 Map 具有相似的语法。此方法可用于启用标准的 Java 国际化支持。

items.source: Special key to distinguish owner.(abstract)=true Default is "false".
items.translation: 用于区分owner.(abstract)=true的特殊键 默认值为"false"。

items.source: Special key to distinguish owner.(class)=com.myapp.MyClass.
items.translation: 用于区分owner.(class)=com.myapp.MyClass的特殊键。

items.source: Special key to distinguish owner.(lazy-init)=true Default is "false".
items.translation: 用于区分owner.(lazy-init)=true的特殊键 默认值为"false"。

items.translation: 用于区分owner.(parent)=parentBeanName的特殊键。

items.source: Special key to distinguish owner.(scope)=prototype. Default is "true".
items.translation: 用于区分owner.(scope)=prototype的特殊键。默认值为"true"。

items.source: Special key to distinguish owner.(singleton)=false. Default is "true".
items.translation: 用于区分owner.(singleton)=false的特殊键。默认值为"true"。

items.source: Property suffix for references to other beans in the current BeanFactory: for example, owner.dog(ref)=fido. Whether this is a reference to a singleton or a prototype will depend on the definition of the target bean.
